title: The Idea for a Fair Trade of Chores
youtube_title: The Idea for a Fair Trade of Chores | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Farah about idea for trading chores that had three parts. Farah wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
